meta.project: POS Authority and Reliability Test APIs

product_overview: This backend provides POS mutation APIs for sales, returns, inventory, and product variant management, with PostgreSQL as the authoritative source of truth. It also exposes testing-only runner endpoints that execute deterministic reliability scenarios to validate replay safety, concurrency handling, and immutable financial/inventory behavior.
core_goals: Maintain authoritative PostgreSQL truth for sales, returns, stock, and accounting
Prevent duplicate, replayed, or concurrent mutations from corrupting inventory or financial records
Preserve immutable sale cost snapshots and bounded return behavior
Enforce tenant and row-ownership integrity across all POS mutations
Provide deterministic local test runner endpoints for focused reliability validation
Ensure derived projections and async workers converge without becoming system authority

features.name: Test Auth Reliability Runner API
features.description: Testing-only endpoints launch focused local xUnit reliability scenarios that verify concurrency, replay, duplicate delivery, and idempotency behavior against real PostgreSQL state.
user_flows: POST /api/test-auth/price-con-11/run with repetitions=5 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/price-con-11/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status and test results
POST /api/test-auth/stock-con-04/run with repetitions=3 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/stock-con-04/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status and replay-safety assertions
POST /api/test-auth/var-con-01/run with repetitions=10 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/var-con-01/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status proving one variant identity
POST /api/test-auth/price-con-11/run with repetitions=2 while a prior run is active -> Receive 409 Run already in progress
GET /api/test-auth/stock-con-07/run/unknown-job-id -> Receive 404 Run not found

features.name: POS Sale Immutable Cost Basis
features.description: Sales and sales returns persist immutable cost price and cost amount snapshots so historical COGS, journals, returns, and replay probes always use the original committed valuation.
user_flows: POST /api/sales with valid sale payload and auth token -> Receive 200 with sales invoice response containing immutable cost snapshots -> POST /api/sales-returns with original sale reference and valid return quantity -> Receive 200 with sales return response using original snapshot cost basis
POST /api/sales with quantity exceeding authoritative stock or invalid payment split -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/sales-returns with refund amount greater than computed return total -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Replay-Safe Cost Basis Recalculation
features.description: Deterministic replay and retry overlap during cost-basis recalculation is fenced by SQL processed-event idempotency so derived valuation can rebuild without mutating historical truth.
user_flows: POST /api/test-auth/price-con-12/run with repetitions=6 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/price-con-12/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status and replay-safe recalculation assertions
POST /api/test-auth/price-con-12/run with repetitions=1 while another run is active -> Receive 409 Run already in progress
GET /api/test-auth/price-con-12/run/missing-job -> Receive 404 Run not found

features.name: Duplicate Financial Projection Delivery
features.description: Duplicate or stale financial projection workers are fenced by processed-event and freshness markers so profitability and BI views converge without changing accounting truth.
user_flows: POST /api/test-auth/price-con-13/run with repetitions=4 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/price-con-13/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status and duplicate projection delivery assertions
POST /api/test-auth/price-con-13/run with repetitions=1 during an active run -> Receive 409 Run already in progress
GET /api/test-auth/price-con-13/run/unknown-job-id -> Receive 404 Run not found

features.name: Product Variant Stock Mutation Support
features.description: Product variant pricing and cost fields can be updated through the authoritative SQL path while stock projection locking preserves historical sale snapshots under concurrency.
user_flows: PUT /api/products/{productId}/variants/{variantId} with valid pricing and cost fields plus auth token -> Receive 200 with updated product variant response
PUT /api/products/{productId}/variants/{variantId} for a missing variant -> Receive 404 Variant not found
PUT /api/products/{productId}/variants/{variantId} with stale row version or conflicting concurrent update -> Receive 409 concurrency failure or equivalent rejected update

features.name: SQL-Authoritative Variant Attribute Combination Identity
features.description: Concurrent creation or replay of the same variant attribute combination converges to one PostgreSQL variant identity, one SKU owner, one barcode owner, and one stock owner.
user_flows: POST /api/test-auth/var-con-01/run with repetitions=8 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/var-con-01/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status proving one combined variant identity

POST /api/test-auth/var-con-02/run with repetitions=8 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/var-con-02/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status proving replay-safe mutation ownership
POST /api/test-auth/var-con-02/run with repetitions=1 while a prior run is active -> Receive 409 Run already in progress

features.name: Replay-Safe Last-Unit Stock Mutation
features.description: Stock deductions, restorations, and duplicate downstream deliveries are fenced so only one physical stock unit effect is committed and derived availability converges from SQL truth.
user_flows: POST /api/test-auth/stock-con-01/run with repetitions=4 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/stock-con-01/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status proving last-unit deduction safety

POST /api/test-auth/stock-con-04/run with repetitions=5 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/stock-con-04/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status proving sales-return replay safety

POST /api/test-auth/stock-con-06/run with repetitions=5 -> Receive 200 with jobId -> GET /api/test-auth/stock-con-06/run/{jobId} -> Receive 200 with Completed status proving purchase-return replay safety

GET /api/test-auth/stock-con-07/run/unknown-job-id -> Receive 404 Run not found

features.name: Replay-Safe Last-Unit Stock Mutation
features.description: STOCK-CON-01 proves one physical stock unit can only be consumed once under deterministic overlapping sales. STOCK-CON-02 proves replay of the same stock mutation identity during an active uncommitted deduction cannot amplify SQL stock, movements, reservations, fulfillment, or derived availability. STOCK-CON-03 proves duplicate stock-sync worker delivery during active projection processing cannot mutate SQL stock, duplicate movements or processed-event visibility, resurrect stale storefront/affiliate/CommerceHub availability, or block SQL-truth rebuild/reconciliation convergence. STOCK-CON-04 proves replay of the same sales-return request identity during active uncommitted stock restoration cannot double-restore SQL stock, duplicate restoration movements, drift returned quantity, duplicate accounting reversal linkage, resurrect stale external availability, or block SQL-truth rebuild/reconciliation convergence. STOCK-CON-06 proves replay of the same purchase-return request identity during active uncommitted stock deduction cannot double-deduct SQL stock, duplicate deduction movements, drift purchased/returned quantity boundaries, duplicate supplier refund/reversal linkage, corrupt derived availability, or block SQL-truth rebuild/reconciliation convergence. STOCK-CON-07 proves concurrent different-request sales returns against the same historical sold quantity cannot mint extra returnable quantity, double-restore SQL stock, duplicate return movements or refund/reversal linkage, expose partial restoration visibility, or block SQL-truth replay/rebuild/reconciliation convergence.

known_limitations.issue: TestSprite must call the dedicated local runner endpoints for deterministic financial overlap scenarios.
known_limitations.impact: Remote Python sleeps or substitute HTTP flows cannot validate authoritative transaction overlap, replay, or journal immutability.

known_limitations.issue: Historical rows created before the immutable cost-basis migration can have null snapshots.
known_limitations.impact: Legacy rows require fallback reads or a controlled backfill policy before strict non-null enforcement.

known_limitations.issue: Cost-basis recalculation workers are projection rebuilders, not accounting authority.
known_limitations.impact: Recalculation replay must preserve SQL sale/return snapshots and journal fingerprints; derived analytics can be rebuilt but cannot become COGS truth.

known_limitations.issue: Financial projection workers are derived visibility only, not financial authority.
known_limitations.impact: Duplicate or stale projection delivery must converge by processed-event and freshness fences while accounting journals and immutable historical valuation remain unchanged.

known_limitations.issue: Stock visibility projections are derived and can lag SQL authority.
known_limitations.impact: STOCK-CON-01, STOCK-CON-02, STOCK-CON-03, STOCK-CON-04, STOCK-CON-05, STOCK-CON-06, and STOCK-CON-07 require projections, duplicate delivery, duplicate worker delivery, stale replay, rebuild, and reconciliation to converge from PostgreSQL inventory truth; remote TestSprite must use the local runner endpoint rather than synthetic HTTP sleeps.

known_limitations.issue: Sales-return stock restoration replay or concurrent overlap is inventory resurrection risk unless fenced by SQL authority.
known_limitations.impact: STOCK-CON-04 and STOCK-CON-07 require sales-return replay or different-request overlap, fresh-reader no-partial-restoration checks, movement uniqueness, returned quantity boundaries, accounting reversal linkage, downstream availability convergence, stale replay rejection, rebuild, and reconciliation to run through the dedicated local runner endpoint.

known_limitations.issue: Duplicate CommerceHub return delivery is inventory resurrection risk unless fenced by SQL return authority.
known_limitations.impact: STOCK-CON-05 requires duplicate CommerceHub return delivery overlap, fresh-reader no-partial-restoration checks, return movement uniqueness, returned quantity boundaries, refund/reversal linkage, processed-event uniqueness, downstream availability convergence, delayed/out-of-order delivery safety, stale replay rejection, rebuild, and reconciliation to run through the dedicated local runner endpoint.

known_limitations.issue: Purchase-return stock deduction replay is inventory deduction amplification risk unless fenced by SQL authority.
known_limitations.impact: STOCK-CON-06 requires same-request purchase-return replay overlap, fresh-reader no-partial-deduction checks, deduction movement uniqueness, purchased/returned quantity boundaries, supplier refund/reversal linkage, processed-event uniqueness, downstream availability convergence, stale replay rejection, rebuild, and reconciliation to run through the dedicated local runner endpoint.
